verdict.rationale: YPOG is a law and tax advisory firm offering transactions, funds, corporate, notary and IP advice, not a software product, so an official CLI is outside its category. The mentions of legal tech and the software-supported YSolutions filing unit describe internal service delivery, not a shipped developer or user tool, and the probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
